headline: Bolivia Declares National Emergency Over Drought and El Niño Risks
summary: Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz signed Decree 5759 declaring a national emergency in response to severe drought and risks associated with the El Niño weather pattern.
why: Severe weather patterns in the Andean region frequently disrupt agricultural production, mining water supplies, and hydroelectric power generation.

impacts.name: Bolivia
impacts.why: Emergency decree signals potential disruptions to local agriculture, water security, and rural economic output.
